visual_brief.subject: Uber attributes more than 70% of pull requests to coding agents
verified_context: Uber reports that more than 70% of pull requests are attributed to local or cloud agents.
Its engineering account describes review, CI repair and maintenance alongside human review and escalation.
visual_brief.editorial_idea: Agent adoption requires coordination and review; attributed activity is not proof of autonomous completion or productivity.
visual_brief.visual_metaphor: A single terracotta workpiece sits on a shared warm stone bench beside several fitted sculptural stone tools, poised for coordinated work. No gears, conveyor belts or literal factory.
must_show: central focal forms that survive cover cropping

candidate_notes.A: Selected replacement: loose solid tools around one central terracotta workpiece; no articulated robot-like assemblies. Strongest focal silhouette.
candidate_notes.B: Viable overhead material study; useful tool/workpiece relationship but more crowded with debris and small shapes.
candidate_notes.C: Viable recessed workpiece composition; larger bench surface and flatter central silhouette make the metaphor less immediate.

golden_reference_comparison: Warm stone, terracotta, architectural depth and restrained supporting lines match the two references. The craft still life is less systems-specific and more photographic, so golden fit is 85. It represents shared work without a literal factory, autonomous-completion claim or productivity statistic.
contact_sheet_renderer: Pillow fallback with two golden references above three candidates. Canonical contact-sheet CLI was attempted but could not launch its missing Playwright Chromium; official browser download returned a truncated/non-ZIP payload. No repository code was changed to bypass this.

generation_metadata.review_type: Codex model visual self-review; no human sign-off

Placement: article hero inside docs/reference-layouts/story.html. This is an artwork asset to place in an existing HTML layout, not a generated webpage.

Visual idea: A single terracotta workpiece sits on a shared warm stone bench beside several fitted sculptural stone tools, poised for coordinated work. No gears, conveyor belts or literal factory.
Output crop: wide, high resolution 16:9 landscape, at least 1600 by 900.
Composition: Canonical: spacious three-quarter view of a shared architectural workbench, a central terracotta workpiece and several large fitted stone tools with purposeful negative space.
Art direction: a restrained contemporary editorial illustration with a quiet scientific or architectural sensibility. Deliberate geometry, fine supporting lines, subtle paper texture, a single clear focal idea, physical materiality, spatial depth and clear hierarchy. Warm canvas #F3EBDD, paper #FAF6EE, near-black #171B1A, muted gray #575D5B, sparing terracotta #8A4B35. Spacious composition, strong contrast and an object-fit cover safe central 60 percent for desktop, mobile and thumbnails. Match the inspected golden references: tactile stone, architectural depth, terracotta and warm print-like grain. Not glossy stock photography.
Depict only the supported abstract metaphor, not a literal architecture, measured result or guarantee.
No words, letters, numbers, labels, logos, interface elements, page header, footer, buttons, badges, charts with invented data, watermark, neon effects, robots, or generic glowing AI brains. Do not generate a headline or imitate a screenshot. Do not produce a bare schematic, flowchart, wireframe, icon composition, or minimalist architecture diagram. Fine technical lines may support the composition but must not be the composition itself. No border or frame.

Replacement for a rejected robot-like composition. ONLY loose unpowered solid stone wedges, a stone straightedge and a shaping block resting beside a central terracotta workpiece.
